query:
SELECT b.id, b.student_name, b.student_email, b.student_phone, b.program_type, b.session_date, b.session_time, b.status, b.notes
FROM bookings b
WHERE DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(b.session_date / 1000)) = CURDATE()
ORDER BY b.session_date ASC;
